facts.business: Primo Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells chemicals, primarily caustic soda and chlorine, along with value-added products such as stable bleaching powder (SBP), aluminum chloride, and flakes, operating an integrated chlor-alkali facility in Naya Nangal, Punjab.

capacity_or_capex.item: Caustic Soda Plant Capacity Expansion Project

auditor.name: M/s. S K Patodia & Associates LLP

key_risks: Asymmetry in chlor-alkali economics where caustic soda drives investment but chlorine must be managed as a co-product, sometimes at a cost
Power cost, source, and reliability materially affect margins in chlor-alkali manufacturing
Future changes in market conditions, chlorine consumption, or performance expectations could impact carrying value of investments
Dependence on North India market with no export turnover
